decision:c0.summary: No concept is worth building yet. The edge-seal kit is rejected because its peak cash need of about ₹9.5 lakh exceeds the ₹3 lakh budget. The standoff mounting set is rejected because each sale loses money even with the founder working free. The delivery-day inspection visit is the leading option only in the sense that it is not rejected; its base-case economics are weak and it must be revised before any validation spend.
reasons_against: Base-case economics for the inspection visit are weak, so the service as modelled does not justify the founder's time.
The leading option survives on lower losses, not on demonstrated strength.
All three verdicts rest on assumed prices and volumes; none is backed by buyer commitments.
what_would_change_the_decision: A revised inspection format (for example a remote check) whose base case clears the economics gate.
Paid or committed buyers at a stated price, which would move demand evidence to level 3 or 4.
Real supplier and channel terms that replace the assumed costs.
